## 1. Introduction

### 1.1 Purpose
Design the technical implementation for enabling concurrent execution of independent SDLC phases using LangGraph fan-out/fan-in patterns within the SDLC Pipeline Graph. The design covers state merge strategy, join nodes, per-branch error handling, and plugin-based extension of the existing `extension/src/langgraph/pipeline` module.

### 1.2 Scope
Technical scope covers orchestration layer only:
- Phase Identification Service for dependency analysis
- Fan-out node creation and immutable state snapshot distribution
- Parallel executor using LangGraph `StateGraph` with concurrent branches
- Join node with configurable state merge strategies
- Per-branch error isolation and join policy enforcement
No UI changes. No changes to Knowledge Module DB schema.

### 1.3 Technology Stack

| Layer | Technology | Version |
|-------|-----------|---------|
| Language | TypeScript | 5.x |
| Framework | LangGraph / LangChain | 0.2.x |
| Runtime | Node.js | 20.x |
| Extension | VS Code Extension Svelte 4 | 4.x |
| State Store | Knowledge SQLite via RemoteCheckpointer | better-sqlite3 |
| Logging | Pino | 8.x |

### 1.4 Design Principles
- SOLID: Single Responsibility for each node/service; Open/Closed via plugin registry
- Immutable state snapshots per branch to prevent race conditions
- Idempotent merge operations
- Fail-fast per branch with isolation
- 200 lines/file, 20 lines/function code standards

### 1.5 Constraints
- LangGraph runtime must support fan-out/fan-in with join nodes
- Existing PipelineAnnotation state shape must be preserved
- Plugin architecture pattern per STATUS.json
- SA4E-204 Parallel Tool Execution benefits reuse

## 2. System Architecture

### 2.1 Architecture Overview
Plugin-based orchestration architecture extending `extension/src/langgraph/pipeline/sdlc-graph.ts`. Fan-out/fan-in nodes are injected into the StateGraph dynamically based on dependency graph analysis.

![Architecture Diagram](data:image/png;base64,)
*[Edit in draw.io](diagrams/architecture.drawio)*

### 2.2 Component Diagram

![Component Diagram](data:image/png;base64,)
*[Edit in draw.io](diagrams/component.drawio)*

| Component | Responsibility | Technology |
|-----------|---------------|------------|
| PhaseIdentificationService | Detect independent phases with `can_parallelize=true` and zero unresolved dependencies | TypeScript |
| FanOutNode | Creates immutable state snapshot per branch, distributes to parallel nodes | LangGraph StateGraph |
| ParallelExecutor | Executes branches concurrently using LangGraph async execution | LangGraph |
| StateMergeService | Implements merge-deep and last-write-wins strategies, deterministic merge order | TypeScript |
| ErrorIsolationService | Captures branch errors, applies join policy, logs per branch | TypeScript |
| JoinNode | Waits for all branches, evaluates partial failure policy | LangGraph |
| SDLC Pipeline Graph | Orchestrates phases with fan-out/fan-in | extension/src/langgraph/pipeline |

### 2.3 Deployment Architecture

![Deployment Diagram](data:image/png;base64,)
*[Edit in draw.io](diagrams/deployment.png)*

VS Code Extension hosts LangGraph runtime locally. Backend Knowledge Service provides checkpoint persistence. No new services.

### 2.4 Communication Patterns

| From | To | Protocol | Pattern | Description |
|------|----|----------|---------|-------------|
| Pipeline | PhaseIdentificationService | In-process | Sync | Analyze dependency graph |
| FanOutNode | ParallelExecutor | In-process | Async | Distribute state snapshots |
| ParallelExecutor | StateMergeService | In-process | Sync | Merge results at join |
| ErrorIsolationService | JoinNode | In-process | Sync | Report branch errors |

## 3. API Design

Functional API contract defined in FSD §3.1.6. Technical implementation:

### 3.1 API Overview

| # | Endpoint | Method | Description | Source |
|---|----------|--------|-------------|--------|
| 1 | /api/v1/pipeline/execute | POST | Trigger pipeline with parallel execution enabled | UC-1 |

### 3.2 API: Execute Pipeline

**Implements:** UC-1, BR-1, BR-2

| Attribute | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Method | POST |
| Path | /api/v1/pipeline/execute |
| Auth | Bearer Token via existing jwtAuth |
| Rate Limit | 60/min |

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "job_id": "string",
  "enable_parallel": true
}
```

**Response 200 OK:**
```json
{
  "job_id": "string",
  "status": "running",
  "branches_executed": 2,
  "execution_time_ms": 1234
}
```

**Error Responses:**
| Status | Code | Message |
|--------|------|---------|
| 400 | ERR_DEPENDENCY_CYCLE | Cannot execute pipeline with cyclic dependencies |
| 409 | ERR_NO_PARALLEL_PHASES | No independent phases eligible |

## 4. Database Design

No schema changes required. Existing Knowledge SQLite stores checkpoints and pipeline state. Phase definitions are held in-memory via `agentRegistry`.

### 4.1 Schema Overview

![Database Schema](data:image/png;base64,)
*[Edit in draw.io](diagrams/db-schema.drawio)*

State is persisted via RemoteCheckpointer to Knowledge DB tables: threads, checkpoints, events.

### 4.2 DDL Scripts
No new tables. State extensions are additive to PipelineState.

### 4.3 Query Patterns
Checkpoint roundtrip uses existing `SELECT checkpoint FROM checkpoints WHERE thread_id = ?`. Performance target <50ms p95.

## 5. Class / Module Design

### 5.1 Package Structure
```
extension/src/langgraph/pipeline/
├── parallel/
│   ├── phase-identification.service.ts
│   ├── fan-out.node.ts
│   ├── join.node.ts
│   ├── state-merge.service.ts
│   ├── error-isolation.service.ts
│   └── parallel-executor.service.ts
├── sdlc-graph.ts
├── sdlc-node-factory.ts
└── edges.ts
```

Each file <=200 lines, functions <=20 lines.

### 5.2 Key Interfaces

```typescript
export interface IPhaseIdentificationService {
  identifyParallelizable(phases: PhaseDefinition[]): PhaseDefinition[];
}

export interface IStateMergeStrategy {
  merge(states: PipelineState[]): PipelineState;
}

export interface IErrorIsolationPolicy {
  shouldContinue(failures: BranchError[]): boolean;
}
```

### 5.3 Design Patterns
| Pattern | Where Used | Rationale |
|---------|-----------|-----------|
| Strategy | StateMergeService | Pluggable merge-deep / last-write-wins |
| Fan-out/Fan-in | FanOutNode + JoinNode | Parallel execution |
| Repository | KnowledgeService | Existing checkpoint persistence |
| Plugin | agentRegistry | Extensible phase nodes |

### 5.4 Class Diagram

![Class Diagram](data:image/png;base64,)
*[Edit in draw.io](diagrams/class-diagram.drawio)*

### 5.5 Error Handling
| Exception | HTTP Status | Error Code | When Thrown |
|-----------|-------------|------------|-------------|
| DependencyCycleError | 400 | ERR_DEPENDENCY_CYCLE | Graph validation fails |
| MergeConflictError | 500 | ERR_MERGE_CONFLICT | Unresolvable conflict |
| BranchTimeoutError | 504 | ERR_BRANCH_TIMEOUT | Phase execution timeout |

Per-branch errors captured as `BranchError { branch_id, error_code, error_message }` and stored in `state.branchErrors`.

## 6. Integration Design

### 6.1 External System: LangGraph Runtime
| Attribute | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Protocol | In-process |
| Authentication | None |
| Timeout | 300s per branch |
| Retry Policy | 0 retries per branch, policy at join |

**Sequence Diagram:**
![API Sequence](data:image/png;base64,)
*[Edit in draw.io](diagrams/api-sequence-parallel.drawio)*

State management for parallel phases:
- Fan-out creates deep clone of `PipelineState` per branch
- Immutable snapshot enforced via `structuredClone`
- Join node waits on `Promise.allSettled` semantics
- Merge order deterministic by `phase_id` sort

Fan-out/fan-in join nodes:
- Fan-out node id: `fanout_${job_id}`
- Join node id: `join_${job_id}`
- Edges: fanout -> [branchA, branchB, ...] ; branch* -> join

Error handling per branch:
- Each branch wrapped in try/catch
- Errors captured, branch continues
- Join policy: `all_success`, `majority_success`, `continue_on_error`
- Configurable via `joinPolicy` in PipelineState

---

## 7. Security Design

No new security requirements. Existing jwtAuth and localhostOnly middleware apply.

### 7.1 Authentication
JWT via `X-Project-Id` header -> JWT `wid` claim.

### 7.2 Authorization
Pipeline execution requires `pipeline:execute` scope.

### 7.3 Data Protection
Checkpoint data encrypted at rest via SQLite file permissions 0600.

---

## 8. Performance & Scalability

### 8.1 Caching Strategy
Phase dependency graph cached per job for session lifetime.

### 8.2 Connection Pooling
RemoteCheckpointer HTTP client reuse via singleton McpBridge.

### 8.3 Performance Targets
| Operation | Target |
|-----------|--------|
| Parallel execution overhead | <10% vs sequential |
| State merge for 5 branches | <50ms |
| Join node wait | No blocking |

---

## 9. Monitoring & Observability

### 9.1 Logging
| Log Event | Level | Fields |
|-----------|-------|--------|
| fanout.created | INFO | job_id, branch_ids |
| branch.completed | INFO | branch_id, duration_ms |
| branch.failed | WARN | branch_id, error_code |
| state.merged | INFO | conflicts_resolved |

### 9.2 Metrics
- `pipeline.parallel.branches_executed` counter
- `pipeline.parallel.execution_time_ms` histogram
- `pipeline.parallel.merge_conflicts` counter

---

## 10. Deployment Considerations

### 10.1 Environment Configuration
Feature flag `ENABLE_PARALLEL_PHASES` defaults true in DEV/SIT, false in PROD until validation.

### 10.2 Rollback Strategy
Disable feature flag; pipeline falls back to sequential execution via `enable_parallel=false`.

---

## 11. Appendix

### Glossary
| Term | Definition |
|------|------------|
| Fan-out/Fan-in | Distribute work to parallel branches then join |
| Join Node | LangGraph node waiting for multiple incoming branches |
| State Merge | Combining state objects from parallel branches |
